init_distributed_process_group: initialize a distributed process group with backend, init method, world size, and rank
gather_arbitrary_data_from_workers: gather picklable Python data from all distributed workers into a single list on each node
reduce_tensor_across_workers: reduce a tensor in-place across all workers in the distributed group using all_reduce
get_distributed_rank_and_world_size: get the current process rank and total world size in a distributed training setup
suppress_non_master_output: suppress print output on non-master distributed workers while allowing forced prints
